goals.0: Advert words: Kaltmiete, Nebenkosten, Warmmiete, Kaution
dialog.2.de.1.n: kalt = the rent of the flat alone, without heating, electricity and water costs
dialog.4.de.4.n: Usually 2–3 months' Kaltmiete; you get it back at the end of the contract
grammar.0.title: Advert words and abbreviations
grammar.0.note: German adverts use many abbreviations. Kaltmiete + Nebenkosten = Warmmiete. Strom (electricity) and Internet may be extra.
grammar.1.title: Ordinal numbers (first, second …)
grammar.1.note: 1–19: -te (exceptions: erste, dritte, siebte, achte). From 20: -ste. In the Dativ add -en: im dritten Stock, am ersten Mai, ab dem zweiten Juni.
grammar.2.text: In Germany the ground floor is „Erdgeschoss“ (EG) and the floor above it is „der erste Stock“ (the “first floor” in British English, the “second floor” in American English). In a building without an Aufzug, think about carrying heavy things up the stairs.
quiz.9.prompt: Put the sentence in order: “The flat is available from the first of May.”
